title: Manifest parity guard and staged hotfix for on-prem upgrade drift
creator: Lena Park
description: Summary: Several on-prem tenants experienced failed upgrades where the operator entered a rollback loop after Helm applied new chart values. Root cause analysis indicates a manifest parity drift between what Helm rendered and the operator's cached CRD representation; interleaved prefix IDs in tenant config caused the operator reconciliation to repeatedly mark resources as changed, triggering Helm failure and cascading rollbacks. Impact: ongoing customer downtime during upgrade windows for ~6 customers (mixed Dedicated/Private), increased support load, and risk of data loss from repeated controller restarts. Goal: deliver a staged, low-risk hotfix that prevents operator-triggered parity flips during Helm upgrades, plus a short-term parity-guard that rejects unsafe manifests with a clear remediation path.
proposed_solution: 1) Implement a 'manifest parity guard' in the operator that performs a dry-run calculation: compute a normalized manifest via kustomize overlay + stable key sorting and compare against operator cache using a fuzzy equality (ignore controlled fields and K8s-managed timestamps). If divergence is only due to ordering or Helm-generated annotations, mark as benign and allow rollout. 2) Add a staged hotfix path: on detection of a problematic divergence, operator will enter 'upgrade-safe' mode for the target tenant where reconciliation pauses non-essential controllers, persists a pre-upgrade snapshot to S3-compatible backup, and applies an atomic merge strategy for KV-like CRs (patch merge on prefix-key collisions). 3) Add safe rollback markers and a one-click remediation script for SRE: snapshot restore + operator leader election restart. 4) Telemetry: emit parity.guard.{allowed|blocked} metrics and tagging with tenant_id + upgrade_id. 5) Release: ship as onprem-operator-2026.03.hotfix with feature flag default-on for new installs and opt-in for existing until validated.
acceptance_criteria: Operator exposes parity.guard.{allowed,blocked} metrics in Prometheus
Helm upgrades that previously rolled back now progress to completion in staged canary tenant (internal test cluster)
No regressions in normal reconciliation latency (measured across 10-minute windows) >5%
Runbook validated: SRE can pause upgrade, take snapshot, and trigger remediation within 10 minutes
Customer-facing incident page template prepared and owner assigned
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: parity guard may mask legitimate config drift - Mitigation: fuzzy equality excludes K8s-managed fields and operator-owned annotations; we initially will enable in audit-only mode for 48h
Risk: snapshotting increases upgrade latency and storage cost - Mitigation: snapshot is incremental and limited to tenant CRs and KV shadows, stored with 7-day TTL
Risk: atomic merge could produce unexpected merges - Mitigation: augment merge logic with strict conflict detection and require manual review for conflicting keys > threshold
runbook: Pre-upgrade: run ./scripts/collect-tenant-manifest.sh <tenant_id> > /tmp/tenant-<id>-manifest.yaml and upload to secure bucket

If operator blocks: toggle operator parity-audit=false and parity-enforce=staged via kubectl patch deployment/operator -n redwood --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/1/value","value":"staged"}]'
Rollback: kubectl -n tenant-<id> apply -f s3://redwood-backups/<tenant_id>/preupgrade-<ts>.yaml && restart operator pod to re-elect leader
Post-remediation: run ./scripts/verify-manifest-parity.sh <tenant_id> and check parity.guard.allowed metric
telemetry_and_dashboards: Grafana: private-upgrades > parity-guard panel (parity.guard.blocked rate by tenant)
SLO: track successful upgrades per tenant over 24h sliding window
comments: 2026-03-10 - Lena Park: Initial triage notes: observed repeated helm release status=failed with controller logs showing 'resource changed during apply' and operator reconcile loops. Captured sample manifests and tenant snapshots for 3 affected customers.

2026-03-11 - Marco Alvarez: Root cause hypothesis updated after heap: KV CRs use composite keys with tenant prefix; Helm template ordering differs across versions leading to reorder-induced diffs. Working on fuzzy comparator prototype in operator locally.

2026-03-12 - Priya Singh (SRE): Canary plan approved. We'll run feature in audit-only mode on staging and one opt-in tenant on canary cluster. Prepared storage bucket and RBAC changes for snapshot scripts. Estimated 2-hour maintenance window for canary.
2026-03-13 - Security review (terse): reviewed snapshot retention and access controls. No blocking issues; recommend KMS-encrypted buckets. Action item: add KMS key usage to deployment checklist.

2026-03-14 - Marco Alvarez: Pushed initial PR: fuzzy-equality comparator + parity.guard metric instrumentation. PR link above. Tests added to simulate Helm ordering permutations. Observed parity.blocked events in staging for 5/50 synthetic upgrades.
